svg.title: it's for you if... I learned with AI and I freeze without it: here you type it all. I ask why. I know C# and I want to learn Go: same method, Go's official docs. I finished the course and I'm stuck in tutorials: your own project, all the way to deploy. I want to review code that AI writes: review drills with planted bugs. I'm senior and I want a sparring partner: I push on trade-offs, no free answers. I want to learn ethical hacking the right way: lab only, with a safety contract. I only have 3 hours a week: a project sized to your time.
